rule: Pre-registration: every strategy definition, its sample window and its gates were frozen (committed to git) before any result was seen. The commit hash is the registration. No strategy definition was changed after first exposure to data.

rows.definition_frozen: Strength-model moneyline singles: bet the side whose fair moneyline differs from the fair line by the largest edge; flat 1 unit; Week 11 slate only at registration
rows.notes: No market prices exist, so staking ROI is not computable (G7 blocked).

rows.definition_frozen: Strength-model total singles: over/under vs fair total; flat 1 unit; Week 11 slate only
rows.notes: Fair total is v1 baseline (league-average only); flagged as limitation DG-C.

rows.definition_frozen: Divisional underdog moneyline singles: divisional road dogs only; flat 1 unit
Two-leg cross-game parlay: two moneyline sides from different games; joint probability computed from measured cross-game leg dependence (not independence)
rows.notes: Cross-game legs are approximately independent (r = -0.007 over week-slates in peer-verified data), but no executable price exists to grade (G7 blocked).

rows.definition_frozen: Three-leg cross-game parlay; same dependence rule as P1
rows.notes: Same as P1: no executable price (G7 blocked).

Multiplying marginal probabilities is invalid under dependence. A same-game combo may be ranked only when a directly validated joint probability and the operator's void/push rules both exist. Neither exists here.

rows.definition_frozen: Player-prop combination (player A over + player B over)
rows.notes: Official per-game player logs exist on nfl.com, but the NFL publishes no prop prices and no prop variance; a prop combo cannot be priced or graded. Blank by policy.

summary: 7 strategies registered: 3 singles, 2 cross-game parlays, 1 same-game parlay (blocked), 1 prop combo (blocked). 0 qualify, 0 reward points awarded. The leaderboard is a rejection machine by design.
